def count_work(n):
    count = 0
    i = 1
    while i <= n:
        for j in range(i):
            pass  # TODO: 每执行一次 work，让 count 加 1
        i *= 2
    return count

tests = [(0, 0), (1, 1), (2, 3), (3, 3),
         (8, 15), (10, 15), (16, 31), (17, 31)]
passed = 0
for n, expected in tests:
    actual = count_work(n)
    ok = actual == expected
    passed += ok
    print("PASS" if ok else "FAIL",
          f"n={n} expected={expected} got={actual}")
print(f"{passed}/8 passed")
